meta.title: The Whisperfen Does Not Forget
meta.author: Moventure generator
meta.blurb: Theme: forest, seed: 11. Choices, dice and stats.

start.title: ARRIVAL
start.text:
The village stops at the treeline and so does the road. Your brother went in three nights ago after the goats. The goats came back.
On the last fencepost someone has left an iron knife.

take_item.title: ARRIVAL
take_item.text: You work the iron knife free. Cold iron. The old women say it matters.

ignore_item.title: ARRIVAL
ignore_item.text: You leave it. You are not here to pick up junk.

hut.title: THE HUT
hut.text: A charcoal burner's hut, door open, fire out. Two bowls on the table. One is still warm.

hut_found.title: THE HUT
hut_found.text:
You touch the warm bowl.
Under the warm bowl is a carved token, carved with a stag. Whoever left it wanted it found.
You make your way back to the crossroads.

hanging.title: THE HANGING TRE
hanging.text: An oak so old it has grown around its own branches. Ribbons tied to every one, some new, some rotten. One has your brother's colors.

hanging_found.title: THE HANGING TRE
hanging_found.text:
You reach for his ribbon.
the charcoal burner's daughter drops from the branches beside you. Don't touch it, she says. It counts them. I know another way.
You feel luckier already.
You make your way back to the crossroads.

hub.title: CROSSROADS
hub.text: A clearing where three paths meet under a sky you can barely see. Deeper in, the ring of white stones glows faintly between the trunks, and you know without knowing that you cannot cross it uninvited.

gate_locked.title: CROSSROADS
gate_locked.text: You step toward the ring of white stones and the forest simply turns you around. You are facing the clearing again. You need to be invited.

end_leave.title: HOME
end_leave.text: You walk back to the treeline and the village lights. Your mother does not ask. Every autumn after that, the goats come back on their own, and you count them twice.

gate_open.title: THE WAY
gate_open.text: You hold up the carved token and the ring of white stones lets you pass. On the other side the trees are taller and the moon is wrong.

passage.title: THE WAY
passage.text: The way beyond slopes down and grows warm. You count your breaths to keep from counting anything else.

confront.title: THE END
confront.text: A hall of living trunks. the Antlered One sits on a throne of roots, and at its feet, asleep or worse, is your brother.

miss.title: THE END
miss.text: You miss, or it does not care. Something hits you hard enough to make the room ring.

end_best.title: THE END
end_best.text: the charcoal burner's daughter names it, and a named thing can be bargained with. You lay the iron knife at its feet, iron for a life, and it accepts. You carry your brother home and he wakes at the treeline.

end_good.title: THE END
end_good.text: You put the iron knife to the root-throne and the whole hall recoils. You grab your brother and run while it screams. He does not speak for a month, but he speaks.

end_bad.title: THE END
end_bad.text: You have nothing of iron and nothing of its name. It has your brother, and now it has you.

end_flee.title: THE END
end_flee.text: You run and the forest lets you. You never go past the stones again. Some nights you hear two voices calling from the trees now, not one.
